compiler_only_output.reason: Homeless. One out-of-line destructor under #pragma defer_codegen off emits D1, D0, then D2. The cartridge has D1 at ov016:0x021111a0 and D0 at 0x02111208 and no D2. Production isolation discards it. It is emitted after D0, and the licensed functions stay ROM-ascending.

include/types.h defines Vector3::~Vector3() inline and empty. The path, lunge and player-relative helpers take Vector3 locals, so this TU emits that four-byte body once as vague linkage. The cartridge's copy is arm9:0x020072c0 (src/_ZN7Vector3D1Ev.cpp); this object is not its home.

The out-of-line destructor is the key function, so this TU emits the vtable. Public address point ov016:0x02114958 is in .data, outside the licensed text span 0x021111a0..0x0211260c. D1 and D0 store this vptr; text-only production discards the emitted copy and retains cartridge data.
This class's __si_class_type_info, dragged in with the vtable. Cartridge copy ov016:0x021148d4. Its base word is _ZTI12dEnemyBase_c.

Owning the key function makes mwcc emit the whole inherited RTTI chain as vague linkage; this is the typeinfo record for an ancestor. The cartridge keeps the canonical copy at ov002:0x021081c0, outside this TU's licensed range (.text 0x021111a0-0x0211260c), so dsd supplies that ROM data independently. romdata_check compares the emitted copy against the cartridge before production isolation discards it.
